thought.text: `mise trust` succeeded. Now installing all pinned tools (this includes node 24.18.0, awscli, 1password-cli, glab, trivy, etc.).

reasoning_content:
The mise.toml configuration specifies Node 24.18.0 and awscli, with a 7-day minimum release age for standard tools and 1 day for trivy. Since we're working with a fixed lockfile, mise will use the exact pinned versions from there.

Installing all the tools — node, awscli, jq, lychee, fnox, git-cliff, hk, 1password-cli, glab, trivy — will be heavy, especially with 1password-cli and glab being large binaries, but it should complete within 600 seconds. I can run the full mise install with parallel downloads to speed things up.

action.command: export PATH="/root/.local/bin:$PATH" && cd /workspace && timeout 580 mise install 2>&1 | tail -40; echo "EXIT: $?"

tool_call.name: terminal
